summary: Verify fix and review-iteration rounds run affected packages since the last clean pass, not the full suite

options.description: After the first full verify, later rounds run vitest for packages changed since the last clean recorded tree plus their dependents; build, root gates, lint and format always run; any root, config, lockfile or non-package path change, or an unreadable record, forces a full run
Docs-only rounds skip build and vitest; test-only rounds skip build
Every round runs the full verify chain
No verify on docs-only or test-only rounds

body: Lever 4 of the duplicate-test-run work. Verify reruns the full build, test, lint and format chain after every developer return, up to about five runs per task. Narrows the verify control made code by AISDLC-1086, hence the weakening tag; CI's full suite still runs before merge.
